newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares surge, uptrend seen lasting.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares surge, uptrend seen lasting.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 3.4 percent as both foreign and domestic demand continued to push the market higher, and traders said the trend could last for weeks to come.
"The demand is very strong. Foreign buying is particularly strong in Lek and Terme Catez," said Bogdan Pusnik, a trader at brokerage Medvesek Pusnik.
* The SBI index jumped 46.56 points to 1,415.4.
* Turnover rose to 459.2 million tolars from 386.6 million.
* Issue A of drug company Lek had the highest turnover, rising 5.12 percent to 30,400 tolars on volume of 9,545 shares. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana Newsroom,386-61-126-3644
